name: Exp_Laguerre
summary: This EA trades based on the Laguerre indicator's trend direction changes, opening buy positions when the trend shifts upward and sell positions when it shifts downward. It uses the ColorLaguerre custom indicator with configurable gamma and threshold levels to generate signals, and includes both entry and exit logic tied to the same indicator flips. Position sizing is handled via the TradeAlgorithms library supporting multiple margin modes.
summary_zh: 该EA基于Laguerre指标的趋势方向变化进行交易，当趋势向上翻转时开多仓，向下翻转时开空仓。它使用ColorLaguerre自定义指标配合可调的gamma参数和阈值水平来生成信号，入场和出场逻辑均与指标翻转联动。仓位管理通过TradeAlgorithms库支持多种保证金模式。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于Laguerre滤波器的趋势方向判断，该滤波器通过gamma参数控制平滑度来过滤市场噪声。入场条件为：当ColorLaguerre指标缓冲区值从1变为2时产生买入信号（上升趋势确立），从2变为1时产生卖出信号（下降趋势确立）。出场条件与入场逻辑对称：上升趋势翻转时平空仓，下降趋势翻转时平多仓，同时如果启用了对应开关，还会在趋势持续时额外触发平仓信号。仓位管理支持五种模式：按自由保证金比例、按余额比例、按亏损后自由保证金比例、按亏损后余额比例、以及固定手数模式。资金管理通过MM参数控制风险比例，默认0.1即10%。止损和止盈以点数设置，分别为1000和2000点，风险回报比为1:2。策略在每根新K线开盘时检测信号，避免同根K线内重复交易，但缺乏对加仓和反向仓位的防护机制。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the Laguerre filter's trend direction assessment, where the filter uses a gamma parameter to control smoothness and filter market noise. Entry conditions: a buy signal is generated when the ColorLaguerre indicator buffer value changes from 1 to 2 (uptrend confirmed), and a sell signal is generated when it changes from 2 to 1 (downtrend confirmed). Exit conditions are symmetric to entries: close sell positions on uptrend flips and close buy positions on downtrend flips, with additional close signals triggered when the opposite trend persists and corresponding switches are enabled. Position sizing supports five modes: free margin percentage, balance percentage, loss-adjusted free margin, loss-adjusted balance, and fixed lot size. Money management uses the MM parameter to control risk proportion, defaulting to 0.1 (10%). Stop loss and take profit are set in points at 1000 and 2000 respectively, yielding a risk-reward ratio of 1:2. The strategy checks for signals only on new bar openings to avoid repeated trading within the same bar, but lacks protection against stacking positions or handling counter-trend hedging scenarios.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 资金管理比例，控制每笔交易的风险占比
parameters.description_en: Money management ratio or fixed lot size

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 手数计算模式：自由保证金/余额/亏损后保证金/亏损后余额/固定手数
parameters.description_en: Lot mode: free margin/balance/post-loss margin/post-loss balance/fixed lot

parameters.name: gamma
parameters.description: Laguerre指标平滑参数，值越大越平滑

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 用于检测信号的K线序号，1为前一根已收盘K线

pros: Laguerre滤波器对价格噪声有较好的抑制作用，能有效减少虚假信号
支持多种仓位管理模式，灵活适应不同交易者的风险偏好
入场与出场逻辑对称且均有独立开关控制，可灵活配置只开不平或只平不开
使用IsNewBar机制限制每根K线只判断一次信号，避免同根K线内重复交易
止损止盈均预设，风险回报比1:2较为合理
pros_en: The Laguerre filter effectively suppresses price noise, reducing false signals
Multiple position sizing modes provide flexibility for different risk preferences
Symmetric entry and exit logic with independent on/off switches allows flexible configuration
IsNewBar mechanism restricts signal detection to once per bar, preventing duplicate trades
Pre-set stop loss and take profit with a reasonable 1:2 risk-reward ratio
cons: 缺乏对现有持仓数量的检查，可能在同一方向上重复开仓导致仓位叠加
没有点差过滤器，在高点差环境下频繁信号可能导致不必要的交易成本
止损1000点和止盈2000点数值偏大，对不同品种和波动率环境缺乏自适应性
指标翻转信号可能在震荡行情中频繁出现，导致反复开平仓造成亏损
代码中包含重复的#include指令（第12行和第54行），属于编码疏忽
cons_en: No check for existing position count, potentially stacking positions in the same direction
No spread filter, high-spread environments may cause excessive trading costs on frequent signals
Stop loss 1000 and take profit 2000 points are large and not adaptive to different instruments or volatility regimes
Indicator flip signals may occur frequently in ranging markets, causing repeated open/close cycles with losses
Duplicate #include directive for TradeAlgorithms.mqh (lines 12 and 54) indicates a coding oversight
improvements: 增加现有持仓方向和数量的检查逻辑，避免同方向仓位叠加风险
增加点差过滤和时间过滤（如避开新闻时段），减少不利市场条件下的交易
将止损止盈改为基于ATR的动态计算，以适应不同品种和波动率环境
删除重复的#include <TradeAlgorithms.mqh>指令，保持代码整洁
improvements_en: Add existing position direction and count checks to prevent position stacking in the same direction
Add spread filter and time filter (e.g., avoid news releases) to reduce trading in unfavorable conditions
Replace fixed SL/TP with ATR-based dynamic calculation to adapt to different instruments and volatility
Remove the duplicate #include <TradeAlgorithms.mqh> directive to keep the code clean

risk_points: 缺乏持仓数量检查，可能导致同方向多笔加仓增大风险敞口
Laguerre指标在震荡市中可能频繁翻转产生连续亏损信号
固定点数止损止盈对不同品种波动率适应性不足
risk_points_en: No position count check may lead to stacking positions in the same direction, increasing exposure
Laguerre indicator may flip frequently in ranging markets, generating consecutive losing signals
Fixed point-based SL/TP lacks adaptability to different instruments' volatility characteristics
